title.narrative: SERVIR Global Science Coordination w/NASA Inter-Agency Agreement

description.narrative: SERVIR team members at the Coordination Office connect NASA scientific tools to existing tools in the hubs and provide support to and coordination of SERVIR projects globally. These team members also help coordinate among institutions within the countries and among SERVIR and its partners in the U.S. and abroad.
